digest.component_or_area: rebar reconciler — inbound link removal applier
propositions: Removal records for managed links lacking peer confirmation should be declined without writing an UNLINK event, keeping the link net-active locally and logging a WARNING.
Removal records for managed links WITH peer confirmation must still converge, removing exactly the named relation via relation-scoped unlink.

A local link whose outbound ADD is deduped by an inward same-vendor-type remote link (vendor collision) is incorrectly removed by inbound removal records and must be protected by confirmation checking.
The confirmation store must be opened once per inbound update pass and threaded into unlink operations; unopenable stores must fail-open and restore current behavior without disabling removals.
Per-pass decline counts must be reported in the existing INFO summary so operators can observe rejected removal records.
